notes: Leave-on 0.5-2% is the common cosmetic range.
consider_separating: high-strength AHA or retinoid at the same step on reactive skin

watchouts.what_to_do: Start 2-3x/week; do not stack with other strong acids or a retinoid at the same step on sensitive skin. Follow with moisturizer.
Use daily broad-spectrum SPF; exfoliated skin is more UV-exposed.

benefits.mechanism: Salicylic acid is lipophilic and concentrates in sebum-rich follicles, where it weakens the intercellular cement between the dead cells lining the pore and disperses the microcomedone plug (comedolytic action, cyanoacrylate-biopsy assay, PMID 6191495).
benefits.what_it_means: Clears out pore congestion and reduces blackheads and blemishes over 2-4 weeks. Because it is oil-soluble it works inside the pore, where water-soluble acids cannot reach.

benefits.mechanism: Keeping the follicular opening clear of desquamated cells and sebum reduces the pore-plugging that makes pores look larger; an 8-week multicenter study of salicylic-acid products showed reduced lesion counts and improved appearance (PMID 33070577).
benefits.what_it_means: Reduces surface oil and the look of enlarged pores with regular use.

benefits.mechanism: Surface keratolysis promotes even shedding of the outer stratum corneum, refining texture.
benefits.what_it_means: Smooths rough, bumpy texture and improves overall clarity.

evidence.summary: Comedolytic action is demonstrated by follicular-biopsy assay and supported by controlled clinical use studies; graded B (peer-reviewed mechanism plus observational clinical) for the congestion/clarity benefits.

citations.title: Assay of comedolytic activity in acne patients
Effectiveness of a combination of salicylic acid-based products for mild comedonal-papular acne: a multicenter prospective observational study

overview: Salicylic acid is the go-to oil-soluble exfoliant for congestion and blemish-prone skin: because it is lipophilic it works inside the pore, where water-soluble AHAs cannot reach, dislodging the plug that forms blackheads and bumps.

ingredient.what_it_is: An oil-soluble beta-hydroxy acid (BHA). Its lipophilicity lets it penetrate sebum-filled follicles, where it loosens the bonds holding dead cells together inside the pore.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: It clears existing congestion and keeps follicles clear with ongoing use, but the benefit depends on continued use and pore diameter itself is genetically set, not physically shrunk.
